turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Doctor: Hello, what brings you in today? Patient: For about the last two weeks, I’ve had rectal bleeding every day when I have a bowel movement, and it isn’t painful. I haven’t noticed any other symptoms like changes in my bowel habits or abdominal pain.

Patient: I’m not sure it’s hemorrhoids—I've had daily rectal bleeding for about two weeks with bowel movements, but I haven’t had any pain with defecation. I don’t think I’ve noticed changes in bowel habits or abdominal discomfort either.
